name: Cosmas
bio: Cosmas is one of the named epigrammatists of the Greek Anthology. Paton’s Index of Authors gives no firm date for him.
This archive carries the 1 epigram ascribed to the poet in the fifth volume of W. R. Paton's prose translation (Loeb, 1918): Book XVI: 114.

poems.title: Book XVI, 114: On Pyrrhus about to butcher Polyxena
poems.author: Cosmas
poems.text: I am Pyrrhus, and am urgent for my father’s sake; but she, the shameless girl, calls on Pallas, though her brother be Paris.
